title: Cyber Aware ca08 trailer, round 1 (narrow-panel takes for the builder and inbox; render 9:16 and 1:1 from this file)

script.heading: ca08 trailer script (After the click)
script.brief: See docs/video/scripts/ca08_trailer_script.md (round 2) and docs/video/takes_ca08.md (recorded 23 Nov, commit fcfaf5e30). Model ca05 (attack-first). Marks-based windows from the recorded takes; Sulafat VO; PeaceFolk Gently Decaying Again window from 6.069 s.

spoiler.note: RE-RECORDED 23 Nov (Niamh visemes, new bust framing). t01 H1: portrait up from about 3.1, speech onset 3.272 (silencedetect -35 dB d 0.08), in 3.12 = onset - 0.15; sentence 1 ends 5.716 (silence 5.716-6.156), out 5.92 = 0.2 s after the last word, 'Proper pain when it happens.' never heard; mouth opens (teeth visible); game bar (whole line plus Skip) framed out, sentence 1 burned as caption; old art and timings in takes/old_niamh_v1; Niamh in her real portrait, no 'playtest' portrait | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

lines.speaker: Niamh
lines.text: Half the floor was locked out of a system earlier.

spoiler.note: t04b: list-up 1.89, hover-card-row 6.63, click 7.45, card-open 7.62; in is the list-up mark; out is 0.03 s after card-open minus one frame so the last shown frame is before the card opens (v1b+v1c need 5.64 s); six rows, '0 of 6 sorted', no verdict, no answer shown | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks
Attack chapter card, title only | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t02: Signing in page up from about 10.5, itdesk block highlighted by 12.0 and noted 12.33, Company news page from about 14.0, news block highlighted 16.0 and noted 16.27 (out 16.3 ends on the note); public facts only (service desk address, single sign-on move) | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t02b: slot1 menu open from about 27.5, slot1 chosen 29.14 (From name 'Quayholt IT Service Desk'); pretext set earlier (closed drop-down), red-flag tell lines hidden by CSS (scrollbar not yet present, it starts about 33 s) | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t02b: slot3 chosen 36.83, counter 1 at 36.86, redflags-final 38.00; THIN SCROLLBAR on the right of the panel from about 33 s: 9:16 and 1:1 framing crops the right edge (cx 0.462 / 0.339 at zoom 1) to drop it, check on the render and swap to t02 if the crop cuts panel text | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t02b: send 39.86, green It landed panel on screen at once; the shot starts 0.26 s before Send so v5 'Send it.' lands on the click; ends before the mail client closes (mail-closed 47.25); pattern level (He would open it / From the IT service desk he acts on / Matches the single sign-on move) | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t03: kiosk-open 4.19, flip-heading 4.49, kiosk-closed 5.74; heading and strip only (body hidden by CSS), the Continue button and the kiosk Close X show; the heading reads 'How it lands on you' (the dry-run doc said 'Now it lands on you'); the t02 flip panel is NOT used because its body is visible there | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t03 A3: portrait up 14.83, A3 audio onset 15.27 (mark a3-audio-start 15.10 = in 15.12), speech ends 24.93 (silencedetect), out 25.087 is 0.16 s after it and before chat-closed 25.97; no menu; Anjali's real portrait from the first line | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

Nothing is cut inside a word.
